column1: # Resyst VK — keywords the emoji search adds to CLDR (r15, ES5 in docs/failure-modes.md). Resyst's own data, GPL-3.0-or-later.
# Read by scripts/gen_emoji_search.py. It only ADDS keywords; CLDR's names and keywords are never changed or removed.
# One line per emoji and language: <emoji> TAB <es|en> TAB <keyword> | <keyword> ... TAB <why>
# Each line needs a reason: a common word a person types for this emoji that CLDR 49 has nowhere (checked with grep over
# annotations/ and annotationsDerived/ of es, es_419 and en).
